item.shamanicmounts.shamanic_saddle.hint: The only saddle a spirit mount takes. Calm a wild adult with a golden apple, use the saddle on it, then ride and answer its fifteen prompts.
item.shamanicmounts.saddle_bags.hint: Straps on under the saddle for two rows of five slots, three rows on an elk. Taking them off tips out what they held.
item.shamanicmounts.diamond_apple.hint: Feed one to each of two tame adults you own, within ten seconds and eight blocks. Any line with any other; one foal, one body.
book.shamanicmounts.tip: Your tames, their genes, and a breeding chapter you can hide.
shamanicmounts.tip.flute: Calls the mounts following you, from any distance. Mounts left on Stay or Wander stay put.
mount.shamanicmounts.ordered.follow: %s follows you, into other dimensions too
mount.shamanicmounts.no_room: %s found no room beside you and stayed behind
item.shamanicmounts.egg.hint: Hatches a wild mount of this line. Its pelt and size lean with the biome's climate, as wild herds do. Calm it with a golden apple before the saddle.
Ride a tame mount up and use the post to offer it. Another rider who uses a post on their mount swaps with you. Sneak-use to offer a gift anyone on foot can take.
shamanicmounts.trade.offered: You offer this mount. Another rider can offer theirs here to swap.
shamanicmounts.trade.offered_gift: You offer this mount as a gift. Someone on foot can take it.
shamanicmounts.trade.hint: Ride your mount here to offer it. Sneak to offer a gift.
shamanicmounts.trade.away: That rider is not at this post.
shamanicmounts.trade.cancelled: You got off, so the offer is cancelled.
shamanicmounts.trade.trial: Break this mount before you trade it.
shamanicmounts.flute.capped: Eight came. The rest are still out.
shamanicmounts.flute.none: You have no mount to call.
shamanicmounts.flute.parked: None of your mounts is following you. Set one to Follow to call it.
shamanicmounts.flute.here: Your mount is already with you.
shamanicmounts.flute.trial: Break this mount before you call it.
shamanicmounts.flute.lost: That mount is too far to hear yet. Be near it once so the flute learns where it is.
shamanicmounts.flute.room: There is no room here for %s.
